text:
harper: hi all, quick intro — harper on platform. setting up a small playground for new hires to tinker with the hosted API. where do i get a sandbox key and who should i ping for quotas if people start hammering it?

devex: welcome harper! Console -> API Keys to create a sandbox key. for a shared playground we usually create an ephemeral key with a few-hour TTL and put it in a secrets manager. if you expect >50 reqs/min open a quota request. who will run the playground (CI, laptop, hosted demo)?

harper: it'll be a lightweight web UI behind auth, hosted in our dev cluster. expect intermittent spikes when classes run (~30-60 rps short bursts).

infra-ops: small web demos are common. default sandbox quotas are conservative and enforced per-project; bursts of 60rps could trip protections depending on total token output. best practice: create a dedicated project for the playground and request a modest uplift in Console -> Usage -> Quota Requests. include project id, window, and expected rps.

harper: can infra set a project-level per-user quota or limits so one person doesn't DOS the playground?

infra-ops: we don't do per-user throttles within a project by default, it's usually app-level. you can add a simple rate-limiter in the UI (token bucket) to protect the project and stay within the sandbox limits. we can also allowlist the demo host IP for steady traffic.

mika: tip: use ephemeral keys and rotate daily. also pin a small model in the demo and set max_tokens to keep costs and token throughput predictable. for UI, show a friendly error on 429 with a retry button instead of leaking raw 429 messages.

harper: perfect. what's the process for getting a temporary quota bump for a scheduled workshop?

devex: open Console -> Usage -> Quota Requests with project id, start/end time, peak rps, and CIDR if you want an IP allowlist. put "workshop" in the description so ops knows this is timeboxed. infra usually approves short windows quickly.

onboarding-bot: reminder: new-hires checklist item "Request sandbox quota" is optional for playground projects but recommended before public demos.

harper: created project playground-hq and submitted a request (window 1773010800-1773018000 UTC) for 120 rps. linked the ticket here.

infra-ops: got it, will review. also consider adding client-side throttling to smooth bursts. I'll add a temporary alert for rate-limit spikes during the window.

mika: example curl for the demo backend (cap tokens):

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PLAYGROUND_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood-1-small","input":"demo","max_tokens":150}'
```

harper: thanks everyone — i'll add per-session rate-limits in the UI and swap to ephemeral keys. will update when infra confirms the uplift. :thumbsup:
